title: Scoped Semantic Invariance as a Foundation for LLM Reliability
abstract: arXiv:2610.33267v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLMs often answer semantically equivalent queries inconsistently, even when the underlying facts are known. We formalize consistency as semantic invariance over equivalence classes of queries and show that invariance under arbitrary meaning-preserving transformations is undecidable in general. This motivates scoped semantic invariance, where model behavior is evaluated relative to bounded semantic domains.   We operationalize this framework using knowledge graphs (KGs), which act as explicit semantic control structures defining local semantic constraints and grounding contexts. Across the MITRE D3FEND ontology and eight Wikidata- derived domains, we show that inconsistencies are structured rather than random, concentrating in localized hotspot subgraphs organized around recurring TREE, STAR, and CYCLE patterns that remain stable across models and domains. translated_title: 范围化语义不变性作为大语言模型可靠性的基础
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）在回答语义等价的查询时常常表现不一致，即使相关的事实是模型已知的。我们将一致性形式化为查询等价类上的语义不变性，并证明在任意保义变换下的不变性通常是不可判定的。这一结果促使我们提出“范围化语义不变性”的概念，即相对于有界语义域来评估模型行为。我们借助知识图谱（KG）将这一框架具体化，知识图谱作为显式的语义控制结构，定义局部语义约束和接地上下文。在MITRE D3FEND本体和八个源自Wikidata的领域上的实验表明，不一致性是结构化的而非随机的：它们集中在局部化的热点子图中，这些子图围绕反复出现的TREE、STAR和CYCLE模式组织，并且在不同模型和不同领域之间保持稳定。我们进一步表明，选择性的图谱接地能够提升模型的正确性和跨模（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出“范围化语义不变性”框架，以知识图谱作为显式语义控制结构，揭示LLM的不一致性是结构化且可定位的（集中于跨模型跨领域稳定的TREE、STAR、CYCLE热点子图模式），并证明选择性的图谱接地可提升模型正确性与一致性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes "scoped semantic invariance" with knowledge graphs as explicit semantic control structures, showing that LLM inconsistencies are structured rather than random—concentrating in localized hotspot subgraphs with stable TREE, STAR, and CYCLE patterns across models and domains—and that selective graph grounding improves correctness and consistency.
